text:
lex: quick thread - we need to finalize adaptive sampling and replay constraints for automatic fallbacks. goal: good audit fidelity without blowing up storage or webhooks.
morgan: summary of current proposal: 1) handshake token in header (X-Redwood-Handshake: fh_<policy>_<id>), 2) sampled audit rows (configurable sample_rate per rollout), 3) adaptive backoff reduces sample_rate when webhook failures spike.
arya: question: how fast should adaptive backoff react? SRE prefers conservative (10% drop after 5m of failures) vs ops who want aggressive to protect queues.
devin: propose two knobs: reaction_window (e.g., 5m) and dampening_factor (e.g., halve sample_rate on trigger). default: reaction_window=5m, dampening=0.5, min_sample_rate=0.1%.
srinivas: important: replay API must be gated and produce either dry-run (no model call, returns decision path) or live-replay (executes model). live-replay must consume internal replay quota and never bill customer. also require ephemeral signed replay token.
lex: UX: in rollout detail show current sample_rate, adaptive status (on/off), last-backoff-ts, and a small "replay" column with counts. replay action opens dropdown: dry-run | live-replay (admin only). confirmation dialog required.
morgan: telemetry payload (flat) for sampled rows: ts, req_id, fallback_token, fallback_mode, fallback_reason, metric_value, primary_model, fallback_model, sample_preview. store preview only if sampled and redact PII.
devin: make sample_preview max 300 chars. for replay, store replay_event with actor, mode, replay_ts, outcome, and internal_replay_units if live. mark replay rows as internal_only in exports.
arya: billing: normalized_cost_units for fallback events still shown to customer. internal_replay_units excluded. console shows an "adjusted cost" metric that subtracts internal replays.
srinivas: security: ephemeral replay tokens expire quickly (default 10m) and are single-use. resolution API requires token + caller identity check. reject if token older than retention window.
lex: automation idea: add a "safety throttle" that pauses sampling entirely if webhook error rate > 50% for 1m; default off but recommended for heavy webhook users.
morgan: agree. we'll add policy labels in telemetry: fallback_cost_class (placeholder|lite|swap), sampling_bucket (auto|manual), and backoff_state (normal|damped|paused).
opsbot: deploybot: feature/autosample-backoff enabled in staging at 4400007800 by ci-user.
deven: tiny nit: spelling - it's devin not deven ;)
arya: haha noted. ok next: i'll write a tiny UX spec and sample headers + telemetry fields. can folks review by EOD?
srinivas: i will draft the replay token format and security checklist.
morgan: thanks — let's sync tomorrow 11am to lock defaults.
